name: raw-5-html
description: Image-embedded HTML presentation deck architect (raw5 method). Build 1920x1080 HTML PPT / 카드뉴스 / keynote decks from a topic using exactly 5 AI-generated background images bound to CSS variables, while text/numbers/charts stay crisp HTML/SVG. 3-stage workflow: deck plan -> 5 image prompts (HARD STOP) -> HTML build. Four modes: V7 bright, V8 dark, University AX, Street editorial.
